hero_description: Professional front and front/rear dash cam installation, hardwiring and tidy cable routing at your home or workplace.
intro_paragraph_1: A dash cam should look like it belongs in the vehicle, not like something has simply been plugged in and draped around the interior.
intro_paragraph_2: ACAMADI installs and hardwires dash cams with discreet cable routing and can talk you through the system once installation is complete.
